title: It Is Important That: Judgments About Agreements

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know *es importante que*, *es necesario que* and *es mejor que* from A2 Unit 27: after a value judgment about what other people should do, the verb after *que* is in the present subjunctive. Agreements about residence, identity cards and degrees are written in just this way: what governments should recognise and allow.

items.spanish: Es importante que los países reconozcan los documentos de identidad de los demás.
items.english: It is important that countries recognise each other's identity documents.

items.spanish: Es necesario que los trabajadores migrantes tengan los mismos derechos que los ciudadanos del país.
items.english: It is necessary that migrant workers have the same rights as the country's citizens.

items.spanish: Es mejor que los trámites sean rápidos.
items.english: It is better that the paperwork is quick.

items.spanish: Es una lástima que algunos títulos no se reconozcan en otros países.
items.english: It is a pity that some degrees are not recognised in other countries.

sections.content: For a general idea use the infinitive (*Es importante reconocer los títulos*); when a new subject follows, use *que* and the subjunctive (*Es importante que los países reconozcan los títulos*).
